items.stem: On an agile team, when should detailed acceptance criteria for a backlog item typically be elaborated?

options.text: Just before the item is pulled into development (just-in-time)
options.rationale: Correct: agile analysis favours elaborating detail just-in-time to reduce waste and rework.

options.text: Entirely up front for the whole backlog
options.rationale: Detailing everything up front contradicts agile analysis and risks waste.

options.text: Only after the item is built
options.rationale: Acceptance criteria must exist before build so the team knows done means done.

options.text: Never; acceptance criteria are not used in agile
options.rationale: Acceptance criteria are widely used in agile to define done.

items.explanation: Correct: agile analysis favours elaborating detail just-in-time to reduce waste and rework.

items.stem: At which horizon does analysis focus most on vision, business outcomes and which opportunities to pursue?

options.rationale: Correct: the strategy horizon concerns vision, outcomes and the opportunities worth pursuing.
The delivery horizon concerns the immediate increment of work, not strategy.
The initiative horizon plans a specific initiative; the strategic choice sits at the strategy horizon.

options.text: None; horizons are not part of agile analysis
options.rationale: Horizons are a core concept in agile analysis.

items.explanation: Correct: the strategy horizon concerns vision, outcomes and the opportunities worth pursuing.

items.stem: Which TWO practices reflect an agile analysis mindset? (Select TWO)

options.text: Delivering analysis in small, frequent increments
options.rationale: Correct: incremental delivery of analysis is central to the agile mindset.

options.text: Using fast feedback to adjust the backlog
options.rationale: Correct: responding to feedback and adapting is an agile analysis principle.

options.text: Freezing all requirements before any work starts
options.rationale: Freezing requirements up front is contrary to agile analysis.
Agile analysis emphasizes frequent stakeholder collaboration.

options.text: Measuring success only by documents produced
options.rationale: Agile analysis measures value delivered, not documentation volume.

items.explanation: Correct: incremental delivery of analysis is central to the agile mindset.
